intro: Manage what you share, how you sign in, and how you invite others.
personalHelp: Edit your private name and location details.
publicHelp: Edit your display name, username, biography, and photo.
privacyHelp: Manage your language and public profile preferences.
passwordHelp: Password recovery requires access to your email. During testing, delivery may be limited to approved addresses.
privateCodeHelp: Your permanent AyiNou reference. Keep it private. Use your email to sign in.
referralHelp: Share your invitation link or code. New members can enter the code when signing up.
invalidReferral: This referral code is unavailable. Check the code or leave the field blank to continue.
emptyReferrals: You have no confirmed referrals yet.
shareFailed: Could not share automatically. You can copy the link shown above.
mfaOff: Use an authenticator app for a second step when you sign in.
mfaConfirmRemove: Remove this authenticator from your account?
mfaSetup: Add this setup key to your authenticator as a time-based code, then enter the six digits it shows. Keep the setup key private.
mfaScan: In Google Authenticator, tap + and choose Scan a QR code. Scan this code, then enter the six digits the app shows.
mfaHelp: Open your authenticator app and enter the six-digit code for Ayinou.
mfaError: Unable to complete this authenticator action. Check your code or try again.
mfaUnavailable: Authenticator setup is unavailable right now.
